title: SEPA+PrEP-Women Pilot Trial for HIV Prevention Among Women at Risk for HIV
official: Pilot Testing the Efficacy and Implementation of SEPA+PrEP-Women Intervention for Women at Risk of HIV
summary: The purpose of this randomized pilot trial is to evaluate the preliminary efficacy of SEPA+PrEP-Women (Salud/Health, Educación/Education, Prevención/Prevention, Autocuidado/Self-Care plus Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis \[PrEP\]). The study will assess whether women assigned to SEPA+PrEP-Women demonstrate higher PrEP uptake than controls and will generate initial effect size estimates to inform a future definitive trial.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-identify as a woman
* Age 18 years or older
* HIV-negative or unknown HIV status
* Report vaginal or anal sex with a male partner within the past 6 months
* Report at least one HIV risk factor
* Not currently using PrEP
* Able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not meet the applicable inclusion criteria
* Currently using PrEP
* Unable to provide informed consent
